descrizione.message: A robot and an apple brawl on the page you are viewing. Grab them, throw them, bet on the winner.

titolo.message: Start or stop the brawl on this page

sempreEtichetta.message: Show the power button on every site

sempreSpiega.message: A small button stays in the bottom right corner of every page: one click starts the brawl, without going through the toolbar icon. To put it there, the browser will ask you to let Page Brawl run on all sites. Nothing is read from the pages and nothing is sent anywhere.

sempreNegato.message: Permission not granted: the button stays off.

guidaIntro.message: Two fighters brawl on top of the page you are viewing. The page underneath stays as it is: nothing is read and nothing is sent anywhere.

guidaP1.message: A news site, a shop, anything you like. It cannot start on the browser's internal pages, on the Chrome Web Store or in PDFs.

guidaP2.message: It sits in the browser toolbar, inside the extensions menu (the puzzle piece): pin it to keep it at hand. One click and the fighters walk in.

guidaP3T.message: Turn it off and on with the button in the bottom right

guidaP3.message: The power button is always visible: it stops the brawl and starts it again without reloading the page.

guidaP4.message: Drag a fighter and let go to throw them. The same goes for the things that fall from above: smoke bombs, jars and weapons.

guidaP5T.message: Open the panel with the glove button

guidaP5.message: There you pick the characters, drop items into the ring, trigger an earthquake or jetpacks, turn on the health bars and bet your tokens on the winner.

guidaS1.message: First to ten: whoever reaches ten K.O.s sends the opponent flying out of the ring, then the score starts again from zero.

guidaS2.message: A thrown jar releases a creature of fire, lightning or water that fights for whoever threw it. A smoke bomb blinds anyone caught in the cloud.

guidaS3.message: The fighters learn: the more they fight, the better they get. What they learn and your tokens stay in your browser.

guidaS4.message: Gore effects are off: if you want them, turn them on from the panel.

guidaS5.message: Super warriors, wizards, duelists, weapons, weather and gravity are part of Premium: in the panel they carry a padlock.

guidaS6.message: Want the power button on every site, without going through the icon? Turn it on in the options.

guidaP6T.message: Take control with the gamepad button

guidaP6.message: A quarter wheel opens in the bottom right corner. The portrait in the corner is the fighter you command: click a slice and they do that move, click the portrait to switch to the other one.

guidaS7.message: Now and then something happens: a storm, an earthquake with an eruption, meteorites. When zombies show up the two stop fighting each other and stand back to back: the horde comes in waves, never the same twice.

guidaS5gratis.message: Super warriors, wizards, duelists, weapons, weather, meteorites, the zombie horde and gravity are part of Premium. For now it is free: open the panel and press “Unlock Premium for free”.

guidaPiede.message: You can reopen this page any time from “How it works”, at the bottom of the panel.
